page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture, specifically powered by Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance does not include any local storage, requiring the attachment of external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps, facilitating reliable data transfer rates for distributed environments. The lack of integrated local SSD storage and dedicated GPU hardware represents a design tradeoff, positioning this instance for workloads that rely on network-attached storage and CPU-bound processing rather than local disk speed or hardware acceleration.

Given its balanced compute-to-memory ratio and high core count, the ecs.g5.16xlarge is suited for enterprise applications, web serving fleets, medium-sized databases, and containerized microservices. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and standard resource density provide a predictable performance profile for steady-state workloads, avoiding the performance variability associated with shared-core or burstable instances.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.16xlarge is a general-purpose instance configured with 64 dedicated vCPUs and 256.0 GB of RAM, utilizing the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 Intel Xeon 8163 processors running at 2.5 GHz. This hardware configuration delivers a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, suitable for a wide range of enterprise workloads. The instance features a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps but does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. This design makes the instance highly appropriate for multi-threaded applications, web serving, container orchestration, and application servers that require consistent CPU performance without the need for high-speed local disk I/O or specialized graphics processing.
